title: Shared definitions
description: Units used across every config file. All numbers are integers so the sim never touches floating point: _x100 means the value times 100, _mt means thousandths of a tile, _mtps means thousandths of a tile per second, _bp means basis points (10000 = 100%), _ms means milliseconds and must be a whole number of 50 ms sim ticks.

id.description: Stable content id: lower case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, at most 40 characters. Player-facing names live in string tables keyed by this id.

enemy_class.description: The six classes shared by aliens (PvE) and raid units (PvP). One counter chart covers both modes.

share_bp.description: A share between 0% and 100%, in basis points.

x100.description: A value times 100, such as HP or damage: 40 HP is 4000.

mt.description: A distance in thousandths of a tile: 1.8 tiles is 1800.

ms.description: A duration in milliseconds, a whole number of 50 ms sim ticks (20 ticks per second).
